The bird is captured in profile facing right, displaying its characteristic long, black, spatulate bill and predominantly white plumage. One dark leg is visible supporting the bird, while the other is obscured by the body or water. The background consists of calm, greyish water with subtle reflections.

To verify the anatomical correctness of the legs, neck, and wing folding, ensuring no hidden extra limbs or structural impossibilities.
